title: Judging the Judges: Confidence and Disagreement in Rubrics as Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2610.21179v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rubrics as Rewards (RaR) extends reinforcement learning to non-verifiable domains by using an LLM judge to score responses against a structured rubric. Prior work has focused on improving the rubric or strengthening the single judge, with comparatively little attention to how different single or multiple judges might be used during RaR training. We first show that judge identity alone produces a substantial spread in scores when training Qwen3-4B-Base on RaR-Medicine and RaR-Science across five frontier and open-weight judges. Building on this, we propose RaRE (Rubrics as Rewards with Ensembles), a novel judge ensemble strategy for RaR with two mechanisms: a soft-Likert reward that uses judge logprobs to weight more confident judges more heavily, and a drop-on-disagreement mask that excludes high-disagreement rollouts from the GRPO update. translated_title: 评判评判者：评分标准奖励机制中的置信度与分歧
translated_abstract: 评分标准奖励通过使用大语言模型评判者根据结构化评分标准对回答进行打分，将强化学习扩展到了不可验证的领域。先前的工作主要聚焦于改进评分标准本身或强化单一评判者，而对于在 RaR 训练过程中如何使用不同的单一或多个评判者则关注较少。我们首先发现，在使用五个前沿及开放权重的评判者于 RaR-Medicine 和 RaR-Science 数据集上训练 Qwen3-4B-Base 模型时，仅评判者身份的不同就会导致分数产生显著差异。在此基础上，我们提出了 RaRE（基于集成评判者的评分标准奖励），这是一种新颖的 RaR 评判者集成策略，包含两个机制：一是软 Likert 奖励，利用评判者的对数概率（logprobs）对置信度更高的评判者赋予更大权重；二是“分歧即剔除”掩码，将高分歧的 rollout 从 GRPO 更新中排除。我们发现这种设计至关重要：虽然对评判者分数进行简单平均的做法无法超越……
tldr: 该论文提出 RaRE 评判者集成策略，通过基于置信度的软 Likert 奖励和剔除高分歧样本的掩码机制，显著提升了基于评分标准的强化学习在不可验证领域中的训练效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RaRE, a novel judge ensemble strategy for Rubrics as Rewards that combines a confidence-weighted soft-Likert reward using judge logprobs with a drop-on-disagreement mask, significantly improving RL training in non-verifiable domains.
